Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response replays the first answer stored for the Idempotency-Key (a stored 2xx or 4xx outcome; a 5xx is never stored).

costPerUnitCents.description: The declared cost of moving one package-unit across the lane on one departure, integer cents; 0 when never declared.

400.description: idempotency-key-required (no Idempotency-Key header), idempotency-key-invalid (not 1-128 printable ASCII characters), malformed-request-body (invalid JSON, an empty body, trailing data, an unknown field, a wrongly typed field or a NUL character), or malformed-request-query (a NUL character in the query string).

409.description: illegal-transition (ErrIllegalTransition): the lane is CLOSED; or concurrent-update (ErrConcurrentUpdate); or idempotency-key-reused (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request).
